anomalies.observed: On the root sheet (PCB.kicad_sch), the VCC feed is interrupted by 10 kΩ resistors R2–R5 whose lower terminals connect to the MCU top supply pins (VBAT/VSS/VDD/VDDUSB). In particular, a VSS pin is pulled toward VCC through a resistor instead of being tied directly to GND.
anomalies.expected: MCU VBAT/VDD/VDDUSB pins should be connected directly to the VCC rail and VSS pins directly to GND; no series resistors belong in the main power paths.

evidence.quote: Root sheet: VCC -> R2 10k / R3 10k / R4 10k / R5 -> U1 pins VBAT, VSS, VDD, VDDUSB
PCB.cir is a flat SPICE netlist with two global rails, VCC and GND

anomalies.impact: The MCU is powered through high resistance and a ground pin is pulled toward VCC; the device will likely not operate normally and there is an unintended VCC-to-GND path.

anomalies.observed: The NFC I2C lines are driven from PA8 and PA9 on the root sheet: PA8 connects to NET0014, which goes to U4 pin 3 (SCL), and PA9 connects to NET0011, which goes to U4 pin 5 (SDA).
anomalies.expected: The specification routes NFC_SCL from PB8 and NFC_SDA from PB9.

evidence.quote: Root sheet: PA8 -> NFC_IC NET0014, PA9 -> NFC_IC NET0011; NFC sheet: NET0014 -> U4 pin 3 SCL, NET0011 -> U4 pin 5 SDA
NFC_SCL net: U2 pin 61 (PB8) — R2 (10 kΩ) to VCC — U3 pin 3 (SCL)

anomalies.impact: Firmware expecting the NFC bus on PB8/PB9 will not communicate with the NT3H2111 unless PA8/PA9 are configured instead.

anomalies.observed: The touch electrode is connected through R10 1k to NET0016 on PB6, while the 22 nF sampling capacitor is on NET0002/PB7.
anomalies.expected: The specification uses TSC_G2_IO2 on PB5 for the electrode and PB7 for the sampling capacitor.

evidence.quote: Root sheet: PB6 NET0016 -> R10 1k -> A1 BTN; PB7 NET0002 -> C24 22n -> GND
TSC_G2_IO2: U2 pin 57 (PB5) — R8 (1 kΩ series resistor) — A2 pin "BTN"

anomalies.impact: Touch sensing is on the wrong TSC pin relative to the intended design; firmware using PB5 will not detect the button.

parsed.summary: The schematic contains a severe power-path anomaly: 10 kΩ resistors are inserted in series with the MCU supply pins, including pulling a VSS pin toward VCC. It also shows NFC and touch signals on different MCU GPIOs than specified.
